blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.3
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.3

blocks.text: कलादीनां तत्त्वानामविवेको माया
blocks.directed: [slowly] कलादीनां तत्त्वानामविवेको माया

blocks.text: Kalādīnāṃ tattvānām aviveko māyā.
blocks.directed: Kalādīnāṃ tattvānām aviveko māyā.

blocks.text: Māyā is non-discernment concerning the principles beginning with Kalā.
blocks.directed: Māyā is non-discernment concerning the principles beginning with Kalā.

blocks.text: Māyā Has Given You Five Absolutely Terrible Subscription Plans.
blocks.directed: Māyā Has Given You Five Absolutely Terrible Subscription Plans.

blocks.text: Now we’re getting into the serious machinery of Kashmir Śaivism.
blocks.directed: Now we’re getting into the serious machinery of Kashmir Śaivism.

blocks.text: Because Kṣemarāja is not merely going to say:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Because Kṣemarāja is not merely going to say:

blocks.text: “The world is an illusion, mate.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “The world is an illusion, mate.”

blocks.text: That would be an extremely inadequate account of Trika.
blocks.directed: That would be an extremely inadequate account of Trika.

blocks.text: Instead, he explains Māyā through the system of tattvas.
blocks.directed: Instead, he explains Māyā through the system of tattvas.

blocks.text: The principles or categories of manifestation.
blocks.directed: The principles or categories of manifestation.

blocks.text: Thirty-six of them.
blocks.directed: Thirty-six of them.

blocks.text: A complete metaphysical architecture describing how universal consciousness manifests as limited subjectivity and the world of differentiated experience.
blocks.directed: A complete metaphysical architecture describing how universal consciousness manifests as limited subjectivity and the world of differentiated experience.

blocks.text: And at a crucial point in that architecture, we encounter Māyātattva.
blocks.directed: And at a crucial point in that architecture, we encounter Māyātattva.

blocks.text: The sixth tattva.
blocks.directed: The sixth tattva.

blocks.text: Followed by five limiting powers called kañcukas.
blocks.directed: Followed by five limiting powers called kañcukas.

blocks.text: Literally, coverings or sheaths.
blocks.directed: Literally, coverings or sheaths.

blocks.text: And these are magnificent.
blocks.directed: And these are magnificent.

blocks.text: Because each represents a contraction of something that, in the supreme condition of Śiva, is unlimited.
blocks.directed: Because each represents a contraction of something that, in the supreme condition of Śiva, is unlimited.

blocks.text: Let’s meet them.
blocks.directed: Let’s meet them.

blocks.text: 1. Kalā — Limited agency.
blocks.directed: 1. Kalā — Limited agency.

blocks.text: Not to be confused with kāla, time.
blocks.directed: Not to be confused with kāla, time.

blocks.text: Kalā here is the limitation of the power of action.
blocks.directed: Kalā here is the limitation of the power of action.

blocks.text: In the supreme condition, Śiva possesses unrestricted freedom of manifestation.
blocks.directed: In the supreme condition, Śiva possesses unrestricted freedom of manifestation.

blocks.text: But the individual experiences:
blocks.directed: [short pause] But the individual experiences:

blocks.text: “I can only do certain things.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I can only do certain things.”

blocks.text: “I have limited abilities.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I have limited abilities.”

blocks.text: “I want to accomplish this, but I can’t.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I want to accomplish this, but I can’t.”

blocks.text: The infinite power of action is experienced under limitation.
blocks.directed: The infinite power of action is experienced under limitation.

blocks.text: Congratulations.
blocks.directed: Congratulations.

blocks.text: You’ve been promoted from the universal agent to a person who can’t find his keys.
blocks.directed: You’ve been promoted from the universal agent to a person who can’t find his keys.

blocks.text: 2. Vidyā — Limited knowledge.
blocks.directed: 2. Vidyā — Limited knowledge.

blocks.text: In its supreme condition, consciousness is not restricted by the epistemic limitations of an individual standpoint.
blocks.directed: In its supreme condition, consciousness is not restricted by the epistemic limitations of an individual standpoint.

blocks.text: But the contracted being knows particular things.
blocks.directed: But the contracted being knows particular things.

blocks.text: And doesn’t know other things.
blocks.directed: And doesn’t know other things.

blocks.text: “I know what’s in front of me.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I know what’s in front of me.”

blocks.text: “I don’t know what’s happening in the next room.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I don’t know what’s happening in the next room.”

blocks.text: “I don’t know what tomorrow will bring.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I don’t know what tomorrow will bring.”

blocks.text: “I don’t know why the Wi-Fi has stopped working.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I don’t know why the Wi-Fi has stopped working.”

blocks.text: An infinite field of possible knowing has been contracted into a particular cognitive perspective.
blocks.directed: An infinite field of possible knowing has been contracted into a particular cognitive perspective.

blocks.text: 3. Rāga — Wanting, attachment, incompleteness.
blocks.directed: 3. Rāga — Wanting, attachment, incompleteness.

blocks.text: This one’s especially nasty.
blocks.directed: This one’s especially nasty.

blocks.text: Because the limited individual experiences desire through a sense of lacking something.
blocks.directed: Because the limited individual experiences desire through a sense of lacking something.

blocks.text: “I need that.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I need that.”

blocks.text: “I’ll be complete when I get this.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I’ll be complete when I get this.”

blocks.text: “If that person loves me, everything will finally be okay.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “If that person loves me, everything will finally be okay.”

blocks.text: The fullness of consciousness is experienced as incomplete.
blocks.directed: The fullness of consciousness is experienced as incomplete.

blocks.text: So now the individual begins searching outside themselves for something that will remove the sense of deficiency.
blocks.directed: So now the individual begins searching outside themselves for something that will remove the sense of deficiency.

blocks.text: Which is a rather unfortunate undertaking.
blocks.directed: Which is a rather unfortunate undertaking.

blocks.text: Because if the deficiency is rooted in the primordial contraction of consciousness, no particular external acquisition can, by itself, completely undo it.
blocks.directed: Because if the deficiency is rooted in the primordial contraction of consciousness, no particular external acquisition can, by itself, completely undo it.

blocks.text: You can buy another item.
blocks.directed: You can buy another item.

blocks.text: Achieve another goal.
blocks.directed: Achieve another goal.

blocks.text: Receive another compliment.
blocks.directed: Receive another compliment.

blocks.text: And the basic structure of wanting may simply reappear.
blocks.directed: And the basic structure of wanting may simply reappear.

blocks.text: The cosmic shopping cart has no checkout button.
blocks.directed: The cosmic shopping cart has no checkout button.

blocks.text: 4. Kāla — Time.
blocks.directed: 4. Kāla — Time.

blocks.text: Now we’ve got time.
blocks.directed: Now we’ve got time.

blocks.text: Past.
blocks.directed: Past.

blocks.text: Present.
blocks.directed: Present.

blocks.text: Future.
blocks.directed: Future.

blocks.text: The individual experiences reality through temporal succession.
blocks.directed: The individual experiences reality through temporal succession.

blocks.text: “I was.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I was.”

blocks.text: “I am.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am.”

blocks.text: “I will be.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I will be.”

blocks.text: The universal freedom of consciousness is now experienced within ordered moments.
blocks.directed: The universal freedom of consciousness is now experienced within ordered moments.

blocks.text: You’re no longer simply examining manifestation.
blocks.directed: You’re no longer simply examining manifestation.

blocks.text: You’re late for something.
blocks.directed: You’re late for something.

blocks.text: Which is perhaps the most humiliating metaphysical contraction of all.
blocks.directed: Which is perhaps the most humiliating metaphysical contraction of all.

blocks.text: Infinite consciousness.
blocks.directed: Infinite consciousness.

blocks.text: Late for a bus.
blocks.directed: Late for a bus.

blocks.text: 5. Niyati — Restriction, order and necessity.
blocks.directed: 5. Niyati — Restriction, order and necessity.

blocks.text: Finally, there is limitation through ordered circumstances.
blocks.directed: Finally, there is limitation through ordered circumstances.

blocks.text: You are situated here rather than there.
blocks.directed: You are situated here rather than there.

blocks.text: Events occur within particular relations and conditions.
blocks.directed: Events occur within particular relations and conditions.

blocks.text: Your actions have consequences.
blocks.directed: Your actions have consequences.

blocks.text: You cannot simply disregard the circumstances through which your individual life unfolds.
blocks.directed: You cannot simply disregard the circumstances through which your individual life unfolds.

blocks.text: In the Trika system, niyati involves the restrictions associated with causal and spatial order.
blocks.directed: In the Trika system, niyati involves the restrictions associated with causal and spatial order.

blocks.text: And so the unrestricted nature of Śiva is experienced through a network of definite constraints.
blocks.directed: And so the unrestricted nature of Śiva is experienced through a network of definite constraints.

blocks.text: Now consider what has happened.
blocks.directed: Now consider what has happened.

blocks.text: The supreme consciousness possesses freedom of knowledge and action.
blocks.directed: The supreme consciousness possesses freedom of knowledge and action.

blocks.text: But the individual experiences limited agency, limited knowledge, desire, time and necessity.
blocks.directed: But the individual experiences limited agency, limited knowledge, desire, time and necessity.

blocks.text: This is the architecture of contraction.
blocks.directed: This is the architecture of contraction.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja’s explanation goes beyond the five kañcukas.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja’s explanation goes beyond the five kañcukas.

blocks.text: He identifies the principles extending from Kalā down to Pṛthivī, the earth principle, as components of the differentiated embodied condition.
blocks.directed: He identifies the principles extending from Kalā down to Pṛthivī, the earth principle, as components of the differentiated embodied condition.

blocks.text: The problem is aviveka.
blocks.directed: The problem is aviveka.

blocks.text: Non-discernment.
blocks.directed: Non-discernment.

blocks.text: Failing to recognise the real nature and relations of these principles and their dependence on the supreme reality.
blocks.directed: Failing to recognise the real nature and relations of these principles and their dependence on the supreme reality.

blocks.text: And here’s the subtlety.
blocks.directed: And here’s the subtlety.

blocks.text: The tattvas themselves aren’t independent evil substances.
blocks.directed: The tattvas themselves aren’t independent evil substances.

blocks.text: They are principles of manifestation.
blocks.directed: They are principles of manifestation.

blocks.text: The problem is the ignorance under which their differentiated forms are taken to constitute an ultimately separate reality.
blocks.directed: The problem is the ignorance under which their differentiated forms are taken to constitute an ultimately separate reality.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explicitly raises an objection from the Vijñānabhairava: if knowledge itself is luminous, how can knowledge be bondage?
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explicitly raises an objection from the Vijñānabhairava: if knowledge itself is luminous, how can knowledge be bondage?

blocks.text: His answer turns on recognition. Through divine grace, even limited cognition can be known as light; without that recognition, Māyā’s differentiating power sustains bondage. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: His answer turns on recognition. Through divine grace, even limited cognition can be known as light; without that recognition, Māyā’s differentiating power sustains bondage. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: So Māyā is not merely someone throwing a blanket over consciousness.
blocks.directed: So Māyā is not merely someone throwing a blanket over consciousness.

blocks.text: She’s the divine power through which unity is experienced as multiplicity without its underlying unity being recognised.
blocks.directed: She’s the divine power through which unity is experienced as multiplicity without its underlying unity being recognised.

blocks.text: And that’s why the doctrine is so radical.
blocks.directed: And that’s why the doctrine is so radical.

blocks.text: The limitation isn’t something that has escaped Śiva’s sovereignty.
blocks.directed: The limitation isn’t something that has escaped Śiva’s sovereignty.

blocks.text: It’s a manifestation of that sovereignty.
blocks.directed: It’s a manifestation of that sovereignty.

blocks.text: The universe has not fallen outside the Absolute.
blocks.directed: The universe has not fallen outside the Absolute.

blocks.text: But the individual is experiencing the Absolute through contracted conditions.
blocks.directed: But the individual is experiencing the Absolute through contracted conditions.

blocks.text: And now Vasugupta is going to explain what to do about it.
blocks.directed: And now Vasugupta is going to explain what to do about it.

blocks.text: Apparently the solution is to dissolve the entire cosmos inside your body.
blocks.directed: Apparently the solution is to dissolve the entire cosmos inside your body.

blocks.text: Naturally.
blocks.directed: Naturally.
